204.description: Shift ended (or was already ended). No response body.

400.description: Malformed JSON body, or a required field was missing/empty (empty-associate-id, empty-path-id, empty-certification, missing-building-id -- neither siteCode nor its deprecated alias buildingId was sent --, missing-shift-id, missing-charge, or malformed-request-body). On the two Idempotency-Key-protected routes (POST /shift-plans, POST /associates/{id}/assignments) a missing Idempotency-Key header is also a 400 (idempotency-key-required).
